title: Clueless Lady Calls 911 On Herself After She's Too Drunk To Start Her Car
description:
On April 1st, 2024. Police responded to a call from a drunk woman who had been drinking an driving saying she had forgotten how to start her car after she parked. It turns out that the woman had turned off her car with the key in the ignition while her car was still in drive.
